Sandbox_SpiffBoy_PlayingEasesMood_toolti: While a console is played, boredom and unhappiness slowly go down. Untick to make playing a pastime with no effect on mood.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_AllowIdlePlay_tooltip: Tick so boredom and unhappiness also go down while the console is simply left running and visible on screen, without pressing any button. Needs "Playing eases boredom and unhappiness" ticked. The battery still drains.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_NoiseAttractsZombies_to: A console played without headphones makes noise that zombies hear. Untick so it never draws zombies.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_BatteriesDrain_tooltip: A switched on console uses up its battery. Untick so the battery inside never runs down; a battery is still needed to switch it on.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_Dismantling: Cartridges and SpiffLink Cable can be dismantled
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_Dismantling_tooltip: Game cartridges give electronics scrap and the SpiffLink Cable gives an electric wire when dismantled with a screwdriver. Untick to keep them from being dismantled. A dismantled console always gives back what it holds.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_CartridgeLoot_tooltip: How often game cartridges are found in the world.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_LinkCableLoot_tooltip: How often the SpiffLink Cable is found in the world.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_ConsoleCartridgeChance_: Chance, in percent, that a console found in the world already holds a game cartridge.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_ZombiesCarryCartridges_: Zombies dressed as students or as staff of Spiffo's sometimes carry a game cartridge. Untick so they never do.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_OthersHearConsole_toolt: In multiplayer, players nearby hear the music of a console played without headphones. Untick so only its player hears it; zombies are set apart above.
Sandbox_SpiffBoy_FastForwardWhilePlaying: In singleplayer, time can be sped up while a console is shown; its game and music keep their normal pace. Battery, noise and mood follow the time of the world.
